neighbours.label: the word completing 'this is / now's ...' when it recommends something ('If you X, this is the time / for you')
fire: If you have always wanted to learn to sail, this is the course for you.
Anyone who loves old films will agree that this is the cinema to visit.
If your garden needs a fresh look, now is the season to plant tulips.
If you need a reliable family car, this is the one to buy.
For anyone craving real ramen, this is the place to go downtown.
If you ever planned to repaint the kitchen, now is the time to do it.
Readers who enjoyed her first novel will find that this is the sequel for them.
If you want a quiet weekend away, this cabin is the perfect choice.
quiet: If you have always wanted to learn to sail, the club offers lessons on Sundays.
Anyone who loves old films will enjoy the festival held every October.
If your garden needs a fresh look, plant tulips in late autumn.
If you need a reliable family car, compare the safety ratings first.
For anyone craving real ramen, a small shop opened near the station.
If you ever planned to repaint the kitchen, buy the paint on sale.
Readers who enjoyed her first novel will also like her short stories.
If you want a quiet weekend away, book a cabin by the lake early.

notes: Card: top peaks are 'for you', 'the time', 'it' after 'this is' / 'now's' following an 'If you ...' clause, also in Spanish ('esta es la'). Quiet items keep the 'If you ...' clause but finish without a deictic 'this is / now is'.
